review_kind: independent mathematical/source semantics and manually authored exact declaration contracts
scope: Pair arithmetic and preservation of convexity, coordinatewise monotonicity, and nonnegativity on a stated domain. This is a compositional library, not by itself an arbitrary-depth Transformer theorem.
semantic_findings: Signed scaling swaps streams for negative coefficients and permits zero; exact arithmetic holds on all real pairs.
Regular explicitly requires both scalar projections convex, the pair monotone, and both streams nonnegative on the same domain; it does not assume a property of the represented signed function.
Multiplication composition consumes nonnegative incoming streams and uses the independently verified polarization primitive. Its isotonicity is not claimed globally outside the orthant.
Scalar and vector substitution use actual Jensen comparison followed by outer monotonicity and convexity; no conclusion is smuggled into a defining hypothesis.
Finite sums include the empty sum through an explicit convex-domain hypothesis.
boundary_checks: Negative scaling swaps and rescales streams
Addition need not produce canonical positive/negative parts
Zero represented factor may retain equal positive common mass
Product global-monotonicity counterexample outside the nonnegative orthant
limitations: This local receipt is diagnostic: production root integration and clean committed gate remain parent responsibilities.
